finalists.label: Tuberous Sclerosis Complex
finalists.why: It has the most specific for evidence, including skin-colored, dome-shaped firm papules and a dome-shaped lesion with several plump fibroblasts and increased blood vessels, compatible with an angiofibroma.

finalists.label: Fibrofolliculoma
finalists.why: It has strong for evidence, including skin-colored, dome-shaped firm papules and a dome-shaped lesion with several plump fibroblasts and increased blood vessels, compatible with an angiofibroma, and no against evidence.

finalists.label: Fabry Disease
finalists.why: It has specific for evidence, including a dermal fibroblast with prominent crystalline inclusions within the cytoplasm and some smaller inclusions forming within lysosomes.
